---
title: "FSMI-RLE"
---

## Overview

Fast Shannon Mutual Information computation on OctoMap volumetric representations using Run-Length Encoding (RLE) for efficient information-theoretic exploration. Computes expected information gain for candidate sensor poses to guide autonomous exploration.

## Tech Stack

- **Languages:** C++
- **Libraries:** OctoMap
- **Methods:** Shannon mutual information, run-length encoding
